B huffed a laugh, loud enough that Jesse snorted himself awake beside her.
“Mmm?” He nosed into her hair, sniffing deeply, and B had a moment of being too fond to speak. “‘Sfunny?”
“Good morning.” She kissed his cheek and enjoyed the way it crinkled with his smile. Those lips... “WAGs chat.”
“Mmmf. They nice?” His eyes were already closing again.
“I have had these women for all of five minutes and if anything were to happen to them, I would kill everyone in this room and then myself.” That probably wasn’t the exact meme, but it was early and Jesse probably wouldn’t call her on it anyway. “Rozanov’s girl is vicious, I love her already.”
Jesse’s thick brows came together, and he blinked himself back awake. “Rozanov has a girl?”
